methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Climate & Energy (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 9 same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Eden Geopower, a seed-stage climate and energy technology company founded by Paris Smalls and Ammar Alali, has raised $19.8M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine peer companies—one public (LNZA) and eight private—including later-stage players like Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (fewer than three datapoints in narrow filters) to support a reliable peer-median valuation approach.

Consequently, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $20M proxy value derived from total capital raised, yielding a $50M implied valuation. This step-up rate reflects typical early-stage venture progression dynamics. No additional triangulation methods are applicable given data constraints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, with $50M as the median point. This range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression result but carries meaningful uncertainty. Key risks to this estimate include the absence of tight peer comparables at seed stage, which limits confidence in whether the 2.5x multiplier appropriately reflects Eden Geopower's specific risk profile and market opportunity within frontier energy. Validation would require additional comparable transactions or detailed revenue/traction metrics not present in the available dataset.
